name: MonarchScopeSelector
title: ScopeSelector
wrapsNative: DisclosureGroup(isExpanded:content:label:) with .disclosureGroupStyle(.monarch) per resource, Toggle(sources:isOn:label:) for select all and Toggle with .toggleStyle(.monarchCheckbox) per scope; a Button with buttonStyle(.monarch(.ghost)) pages the groups
summary: Chooses the scopes (permissions) to grant, grouped by resource such as an API, with a per-group count, select all, loading groups, paging and optional auto-selection.
whenToUse: When creating or editing an API key, an OAuth app or an integration grant that is limited to a set of scopes.
whenNotToUse: For a short flat list of choices use MonarchCheckboxGroup; for role-based access (viewer, editor, admin) use a Picker; for an AI assistant's permissions see ai-permission-scope.
api: MonarchScopeSelector.init(_ label: String, selection: Binding<Set<String>>, groups: [MonarchScopeGroup], initiallyExpanded: Set<String> = [], isLabelHidden: Bool = false, isReadOnly: Bool = false, pageSize: Int = 10, autoSelect: MonarchScopeSelectorAutoSelect? = nil, labels: MonarchScopeSelectorLabels = MonarchScopeSelectorLabels())
MonarchScopeGroup.init(id: String, label: String, description: String? = nil, systemImage: String? = nil, scopes: [MonarchScopeOption], isLoading: Bool = false, emptyMessage: String? = nil)
MonarchScopeOption.init(_ value: String, label: String? = nil, description: String? = nil, isDisabled: Bool = false)

options.name: label
options.description: The visible title, such as "Scopes". It also names the selector for VoiceOver.

options.name: groups
options.description: The resources in order, each with a name, an optional description and symbol, its scopes, a loading flag and an empty message.

options.name: initiallyExpanded
options.description: The ids of the groups open at first. Pass every id to open them all.

options.name: isLabelHidden
options.description: Hides the title; VoiceOver still reads it as the container's name.

options.name: isReadOnly
options.description: Disables every checkbox and hides select all; the groups still open so the grant can be reviewed.

options.name: pageSize
options.description: How many groups show before "Show 10 more of 25", and how many each tap adds.

options.name: autoSelect
options.description: .all selects every enabled scope of each group that loads with none selected, once per group; .added does it only for groups added after the selector appears.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the empty message, Loading scopes…, No scopes available., the count, Select all and Show more.

states.name: collapsed
states.description: A group shows its name, description and "0 of 2 scopes".

states.name: expanded
states.description: Select all (checked, mixed or clear) above the indented scope checkboxes, each with its description.

states.name: granted
states.description: A group with selected scopes shows its count in the accent colour.

states.name: loading
states.description: The summary reads "Loading scopes…" and the content is a progress indicator.

states.name: no scopes
states.description: The summary reads "No scopes available." or the group's emptyMessage, and the group has no content.

states.name: empty
states.description: With no groups, "There are no scopes to choose from."

states.name: read only
states.description: Checkboxes are disabled and select all is hidden; groups still open.

states.name: paged
states.description: Past pageSize, a Show 10 more of 25 button adds the next page.

appearance: Groups are separated by dividers; names use the default text role, descriptions the muted role, scope strings the code font, and a granted group's count the accent strong role. Checkboxes use the Monarch checkbox style in every theme.
platformNotes: The web ScopeSelector puts Select all / Clear all as a button on each group header, so a group can be granted without opening it, and moves focus to the first new group after Show more. On iOS select all is the system's Toggle(sources:) inside the open group, with the system's mixed state, and focus after paging is left to VoiceOver. The web's emptyState slot is the empty text here; use the labels to change it. Group icons are SF Symbols. Android builds the same component with the same name.
accessibility: The selector is a container named by its label; the visible label has the header trait.
Each group header is one button that reads the name, the description, the summary ("1 of 2 scopes") and Expanded or Collapsed. The symbol is decorative.
Select all is a checkbox whose value is on, off or mixed.
Each scope is a checkbox read with its label, or its scope string, and its description.
A loading group's progress indicator is named "Loading scopes…".
Every checkbox and button has a touch target of at least 44 by 44 points and the text scales with Dynamic Type.
edgeCases: Auto-selection runs once per group id, only after the group has loaded and only when none of its scopes is selected; clearing them later is respected.
Disabled scopes keep their state; select all skips them.
Selected values not in any group are kept in the selection.
Long API names and scope strings wrap at the largest text sizes.

examples.title: Scopes for a key
examples.template:
MonarchScopeSelector(
    {{label}},
    selection: $scopes,
    groups: [
        MonarchScopeGroup(id: {{groups.0.id}}, label: {{groups.0.label}}, description: {{groups.0.description}}, scopes: [
            MonarchScopeOption({{groups.0.scopes.0.value}}, description: {{groups.0.scopes.0.description}}),
            MonarchScopeOption({{groups.0.scopes.1.value}}, description: {{groups.0.scopes.1.description}}),
        ]),
        MonarchScopeGroup(id: {{groups.1.id}}, label: {{groups.1.label}}, description: {{groups.1.description}}, scopes: [
            MonarchScopeOption({{groups.1.scopes.0.value}}, description: {{groups.1.scopes.0.description}}),
            MonarchScopeOption({{groups.1.scopes.1.value}}, description: {{groups.1.scopes.1.description}}),
        ]),
    ],
    initiallyExpanded: [{{expanded}}]
)
examples.code:
MonarchScopeSelector(
    "Scopes",
    selection: $scopes,
    groups: [
        MonarchScopeGroup(id: "projects", label: "Projects API", description: "Example Inc.", scopes: [
            MonarchScopeOption("projects:read", description: "List and read projects."),
            MonarchScopeOption("projects:write", description: "Create, update and archive projects."),
        ]),
        MonarchScopeGroup(id: "reports", label: "Reports API", description: "Example Inc.", scopes: [
            MonarchScopeOption("reports:read", description: "Read generated reports."),
            MonarchScopeOption("reports:export", description: "Download reports as files."),
        ]),
    ],
    initiallyExpanded: ["projects"]
)

examples.title: Loading groups with auto-selection
examples.code:
MonarchScopeSelector(
    "Scopes",
    selection: $scopes,
    groups: [MonarchScopeGroup(id: "projects", label: "Projects API", scopes: [], isLoading: true)],
    autoSelect: .all
)
